notes.title: Patch 1.1 and DEMO are live now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300974/164e4c031fc732dbc2fa75ac30873cfdf6ec2400.jpg[/img]

-Over the last couple of weeks, we’ve watched dozens of hours of playthroughs and gathered valuable player feedback. Our first update introduces quality-of-life improvements and aims to clarify battle mechanics by enhancing the user interface.

What´s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300974/bf965193c43eddeacd6e2df2fa08cb347920d7c8.jpg[/img]

-Creatures that will take collision damage when pushed against objects or other creatures now have a new preview icon above them. The collision damage is also displayed as a separate number.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300974/62275757a0333a7f8973d1bc74e8b79691aa586d.jpg[/img]

-Added new icons for collecting mana and healing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300974/cd9e8b25b257be2de7ceb91f96c51185c31bc74d.jpg[/img]

-Attack preview: A new white creature outline now indicates which tile the creature will move to.

 -Added new tooltip for tiles that will spawn mana.

-Mini Creatures now have segmented health bars to visualize how many Mini Creatures remain.

-Improved the tutorial.

-Creature info now also shows the crit chance (which is usually 15%).

-Minor bug fixes and SFX improvements.

And our game DEMO is live now!

Thank you for playing. We hope you enjoy these changes. :)

notes.title: 🔥 Eldrador® Creatures Shadowfall – OUT NOW! 🔥
notes.notes:
Prepare for tactical battles, explosive action, and legendary creatures in this thrilling strategy game.

🔥 TACTICAL DEPTH – Freeze your opponent first? Push them against an obstacle? Or scorch multiple enemies at once with fire breath? Use a variety of accessible tactics to outwit your foes!

⚔️ ACTION-PACKED FIGHTS – Bombastic attacks with spectacular effects make the beautifully crafted world of Eldrador tremble.

🌍 FANTASTIC WORLDS – Explore four unique and freely accessible locations: the scorching Lava World, the perilous Ice World, the indestructible Stone World, and the overgrown Jungle World.

🎭 A HUMOROUS STORY – Follow a cast of unusual characters through more than 100 levels in a tongue-in-cheek adventure full of charm and humor.

🐉 MIGHTY CREATURES – Assemble your dream team of 20 powerful creatures, each with unique abilities that grow stronger with every battle.

🎮 EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER – A game designed for newcomers and children, yet offering a real challenge for strategy veterans with customizable difficulty levels.

🎵 IMMERSIVE AUDIO EXPERIENCE – Fully voiced in both German and English, accompanied by a groovy soundtrack by Tim Grathwohl.

⚡ The battle for Eldrador begins NOW! Will you seize control and lead your creatures to victory? Play today!

notes.title: Eldrador® Creatures Shadowfall - Launching March 6!
notes.notes:
The battle for Eldrador begins! Eldrador® Creatures Shadowfall - get ready for intense, tactical combat in a world full of epic creatures and strategic depth.

Choose from 20 powerful Creatures, each with unique abilities, and engage in thrilling battles across four diverse worlds: the fiery Lava World, the cold Ice World, the unyielding Stone World, and the overgrown Jungle World. Outsmart your enemies with devastating attacks—freeze them, push them into obstacles, or scorch multiple foes at once!

With over 100 levels and a humorous and action-packed story Eldrador® Creatures Shadowfall is easy to learn but challenging to master. Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned strategist, this adventure will put your skills to the test!

Launching March 6! 🔥❄️🌿🪨
